title: Triage Copilot
summary: An internal tool that enriches SOC alerts with threat intel context before an analyst even opens the ticket.
description: Triage Copilot listens to a SIEM webhook, enriches each alert with WHOIS, VirusTotal, and internal asset-criticality data, then writes a scored summary back into the ticket. It cut median time-to-first-action for tier-1 alerts significantly during a three month pilot.
challenges: Balancing enrichment speed against third-party API rate limits meant building an aggressive local cache layer.
lessons: Analysts trusted the tool more once it showed its reasoning, not just a score.
